engineering_consequence: A shipped anchor check that compares raw bytes will report false anchor failures on ordinary published prose. Normalize to NFC and fold the curly/straight quote, en/em/minus dash, and non-breaking/thin/zero-width space classes on BOTH sides before comparing. Do not fold case, digits, or whitespace runs that carry meaning inside code or formulae.
